title: No stuck nudge for cloud pi-durable workers; A3's nudge clause is local-only
description:
sandboxExecutor passes no StuckAfter, and internal/exec/cloudflaresandbox has no stuck logic. The WorkerAgent's steer is reached only by the operator routes, although worker-attempt.ts and sandbox-dispatch.ts both say 'the stuck nudge is one of these'. A cloud attempt stuck on a hung bash (pi-durable's bash has no default timeout) runs to its wall deadline. This is not a regression, since main had no cloud nudge, but A3's 'the stuck nudge is a steer' holds only locally.
evidence: internal/cli/executor.go:185-209; harness/src/host/worker-attempt.ts:349; cloudflare/src/sandbox-dispatch.ts:882
